title: Sgt. Chapman and Larry
description: Sgt. Chapman — an E7, Larry says — and Larry (right) pose shirtless, hands on hips, before a water-stained reed-mat panel that was likely the shower enclosure, metal-roofed hooches and a web of utility wires behind them.
researchNotes: Larry's own identification (Memories comment, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0024-c18032301.json). This substantially revises the Chapman picture: previously only a name from a phone call with a basic-training working hypothesis, Chapman is now placed in Vietnam — photographed at the T-building camp — with a rank (E7, sergeant first class). The survey's read of the older man as a senior NCO in his 40s fits. Unresolved question #8 updated.
